message.content: {"note_claim": "The story that Hakimi put all his assets in his mother's name is not true/was denied (the note's link is cited as a fact-check that the viral posts are fake).", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "In conclusion, from DUBAWA’s investigation, there is no evidence supporting the claim that Hakimi has registered a larger chunk of his property in his mother’s name to prevent his wife from acquiring a portion of the property after the divorce.", "reason": "The page debunks the assets-in-mother's-name claim as originating from a parody account, but it does not mention the 2023 Spanish divorce, the €10M demand, the €2M offer, or any denial by Hakimi's mother."}

parsed.note_claim: The story that Hakimi put all his assets in his mother's name is not true/was denied (the note's link is cited as a fact-check that the viral posts are fake).
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: In conclusion, from DUBAWA’s investigation, there is no evidence supporting the claim that Hakimi has registered a larger chunk of his property in his mother’s name to prevent his wife from acquiring a portion of the property after the divorce.
parsed.reason: The page debunks the assets-in-mother's-name claim as originating from a parody account, but it does not mention the 2023 Spanish divorce, the €10M demand, the €2M offer, or any denial by Hakimi's mother.
